method: Connected dark oral/ink component in bounded eye-relative ROI. Coarse iris anchors define local coordinates. Convex envelope is an alternative control candidate, not an accepted lip mask.
limits: Dark threshold omits bright lip rim/teeth.
Convex envelope can include teeth but can overfill lip curvature.
Closed smile bounding-box height is curved ink, not jaw opening.
No pixel-aligned rig, deformation, motion, lip sync or human mouth-attachment acceptance.
